project.name: Lumen
project.tagline: A fictional offline-first notes app, used as sample data for the status-report skill.

health.summary: Three releases in two weeks and no open pull requests. The nightly CI run is red on one flaky test, so the manual release check is the gate for now.

happened.title: Tag filter remembers its last selection
happened.detail: The sidebar keeps the chosen tags across restarts and no longer resets after a sync.

happened.title: Android beta joins the release train
happened.detail: The Android build is produced by the same pipeline as desktop and ships behind an opt-in toggle.

happened.title: Sync no longer follows a replaced symlink
happened.detail: The importer refuses links that point outside the notes folder and reports the skipped file.

happened.title: Unsaved edits survive a crash during sync
happened.detail: Drafts are written to a recovery file before each sync and restored on the next start.

happened.title: Local-first storage replaces the JSON export
happened.detail: Notes are stored in a local database; the JSON export stays as a one-way backup.

happening.title: Shared notebooks
happening.progress_basis: 2 of 5 milestones in the design brief are merged
happening.note: Conflict handling is the open question; a prototype of both options is being compared.

happening.title: iOS beta
happening.note: Waiting for the signing certificate renewal before a build can be uploaded.

next.title: Pick the new editor toolbar design

risks.title: Nightly CI is red on one flaky test
risks.detail: The sync timing test failed in four of the last ten nightly runs.
risks.mitigation: The manual release check runs the test three times before every release.

risks.title: Fast release cadence
risks.detail: Three releases in nine days leave little time to notice regressions between them.
risks.mitigation: Every release passes the release check and can be rolled back from the app.

risks.title: Desktop builds are not notarized
risks.detail: The first start is stopped by the operating system and needs a manual override.
risks.mitigation: Every release note describes the step.

decisions.title: Android ships as an opt-in beta
decisions.why: The pipeline is shared, but device coverage is still small.

decisions.title: Local database instead of JSON files
decisions.why: Search and sync need indexed access; the JSON export remains for backups.

decisions.title: Release notes are written per release
decisions.why: The in-app changelog reads them directly, so they are the single source.

sources.label: gh workflow list, gh run list

gaps: No test numbers: only the nightly run status was read, not the test logs.
Plans after 2026-10-30 exist only in the maintainer's brief and local notes, not in the repository.
